import pytest

def test_pass():
    assert 1 == 1

class TestCart:
    def test_numbers(self):
        assert 1 == 2

    def test_names(self):
        assert "robin" == "sam"

@pytest.mark.skip(reason="not ready")
def test_skip():
    pass

@pytest.mark.xfail(reason="todo")
def test_todo():
    assert False

@pytest.mark.parametrize("n", [1, 2])
def test_parameter(n):
    assert n > 0

@pytest.fixture
def broken():
    raise RuntimeError("fixture boom")

def test_fixture_error(broken):
    pass
